name: 58-vitest-deadline-release-operations
title: Release tracked operations when a task deadline is cleared
body: TaskDeadline kept references to tracked operations until each one settled, even after the task finished and the timer was cleared. clear() now empties the set, and the untracking callback in track() is expanded into a block with a comment.

bugs.why: The promise returned by .finally() is no longer caught, so whenever a tracked operation rejects it produces an extra unhandled rejection that Vitest reports as an error.
